document.title: CreateTO and TO Live announce shortlist for St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts design competition
document.summary: News release announcing the five-team shortlist for the international design competition to reimagine the St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts (STLC) at 27 Front St. East, with timeline for jury adjudication, council consideration, and amended construction start.

document.title: CreateTO and TO Live announce winner of the St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts Design Competition
document.summary: News release announcing Hariri Pontarini Architects and team as winning design team for the St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts (STLC) Design Competition, with the winning design 'Transparence' to go to Executive Committee and City Council in Q3 2023.
